title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 10:12 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 10:12 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z). Last-180-sample maximum is 1.67 (at 08:18 UTC); published-window maximum is 2.67 (at 04:57 UTC). Hours through 03:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 04:00 UTC slice: peak 2.67 / 3M (45 samples from 04:15, closed at 2.33 / 2P). Completed bins 05:00–09:00 UTC closed at 2.67 / 1.00 / 1.00 / 1.67 / 0.33 respectively (05:00 peak 2.67 / 3M; 07:00 peak 1.33 / 1P; 08:00 peak 1.67 / 2M; 09:00 peak 0.33 / 0P). 10:00 UTC bin is in progress (13 samples; peak 0.33 / 0P, last 0.00 / 0Z). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~355 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 10:00 UTC hour currently ends at 0.00 / 0Z and may be revised as NOAA updates.

title.en: A magnitude 4.8 earthquake occurred 268 km NNW of Kuril’sk, Russia on 19 September 2026.

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.8, depth about 394 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum remains mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.8，深度約 394 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大仍為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
